answer: Building insurance tenure with annual renewals is the check: a building policy renewed with one insurer for a decade. A farm faking 345 aliases needs 345 separate policy tenures, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. The lagoon check runs in the open: 345 fakes pay the full price 345 times, one honest agent pays once, and the oasis trail in the ledger makes the whisper cost visible to everyone.
